steps.en: Officer selects an email template and opens the edit screen
steps.id: Officer memilih template email dan membuka layar edit

steps.en: Officer edits the email subject and body
steps.id: Officer mengedit subject dan isi email

steps.en: Officer enters an email address for the test in a field
steps.id: Officer mengisi alamat email untuk test di sebuah field
steps.why_en: The edit screen has no email address field.
steps.why_id: Layar edit tidak punya field alamat email.

steps.en: The edited email arrives as a test message
steps.id: Email hasil edit diterima sebagai pesan test
steps.why_en: No test send exists; the screen cannot send an email to an address.
steps.why_id: Fitur test send tidak ada; layar tidak bisa mengirim email ke sebuah alamat.
